SELECT CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' THEN 'TY' ELSE 'LY' END AS per,
 s.store_id >= 900 AS nonstore, f.channel_code, f.staff_purchase_flag,
 count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_line, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dist_rl,
 sum(f.net_amount) AS net, min(f.sale_date) mind, max(f.sale_date) maxd, min(f.etl_loaded_at) minload, max(f.etl_loaded_at) maxload,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 OR f.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key)
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT d.calendar_date, d.fiscal_week, d.is_trading_day, d.is_public_holiday, d.holiday_name
FROM dim_date d
WHERE (d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' OR d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24') AND (NOT d.is_trading_day OR d.is_public_holiday)
UNION ALL
SELECT calendar_date, fiscal_week, is_trading_day, is_public_holiday, 'FIRST/LAST '||fiscal_year||' P'||fiscal_period FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date IN (DATE '2026-08-03', DATE '2026-08-30', DATE '2025-07-28', DATE '2025-08-24')
ORDER BY 1

WITH per AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('LY',DATE '2025-07-28',DATE '2025-08-24'),('TY',DATE '2026-08-03',DATE '2026-08-30')) t(p,s,e)),
rpt AS (SELECT p, sum(net_sales_before_returns) gross_rpt, sum(returns_net) ret_rpt, sum(net_sales) net_rpt, count(*) n_rows, count(DISTINCT store_id) n_st, max(store_id) mx
        FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN per ON r.business_date BETWEEN s AND e WHERE store_id < 900 GROUP BY p),
fs AS (SELECT p, sum(net_amount) all_st, sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag THEN net_amount END) excl_staff, count(DISTINCT st.store_id) n_st
       FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key) JOIN per ON f.sale_date BETWEEN s AND e WHERE st.store_id < 900 GROUP BY p),
fr AS (SELECT p, sum(refund_net) ref_all, count(*) n_ref, count(DISTINCT return_line_id) d_ref, sum(CASE WHEN st.store_id<900 THEN refund_net END) ref_store
       FROM fact_return_line f JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key) JOIN per ON f.return_date BETWEEN s AND e GROUP BY p)
SELECT * FROM rpt JOIN fs USING (p) JOIN fr USING (p) ORDER BY p

WITH x AS (
 SELECT r.store_id,
  sum(CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24' THEN r.net_sales END) AS ly,
  sum(CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' THEN r.net_sales END) AS ty,
  sum(CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24' THEN r.receipts END) AS ly_rc,
  sum(CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' THEN r.receipts END) AS ty_rc
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r WHERE r.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT x.store_id, s.store_name, ly, ty, round(100*(ty/ly-1),1) AS g, ly_rc, ty_rc, round(100*(ty_rc*1.0/ly_rc-1),1) AS grc
FROM x LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id=x.store_id AND s.is_current ORDER BY g

SELECT r.store_id, CASE WHEN r.business_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN 'TY' ELSE 'LY' END AS per, d.fiscal_week,
  count(*) AS days, sum(r.receipts) rc, sum(r.units_sold) units, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) gross, sum(r.returns_net) ret, sum(r.net_sales) net
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id IN (127,109,105,103) AND (r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24' OR r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH lines AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24' THEN 'LY' WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' THEN 'TY' END AS per,
         f.net_amount AS amt, f.staff_purchase_flag AS staff
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key) WHERE st.store_id < 900
  UNION ALL
  SELECT st.store_id, CASE WHEN r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24' THEN 'LY' WHEN r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' THEN 'TY' END,
         -r.refund_net, coalesce(o.staff_purchase_flag,false)
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key) LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line o ON o.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id WHERE st.store_id < 900),
v AS (SELECT * FROM lines WHERE per IS NOT NULL)
SELECT variant, round(sum(CASE WHEN per='LY' THEN amt END),2) AS ly, round(sum(CASE WHEN per='TY' THEN amt END),2) AS ty,
  round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN per='TY' THEN amt END)/sum(CASE WHEN per='LY' THEN amt END)-1),3) AS growth_pct, count(DISTINCT store_id) AS n_stores
FROM v CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
 ('A main', store_id NOT IN (129,136,137), true),
 ('B excl staff', store_id NOT IN (129,136,137), NOT staff),
 ('C excl Kuopio,Pori', store_id NOT IN (129,136,137,125,119), true),
 ('D incl 136,137', store_id NOT IN (129), true),
 ('E all stores both periods', store_id NOT IN (129), true)
) m(variant, store_ok, row_ok)
WHERE store_ok AND row_ok GROUP BY variant ORDER BY variant

WITH ty AS (SELECT period_start_date AS s, period_end_date AS e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=4),
ly AS (SELECT period_start_date AS s, period_end_date AS e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=4),
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900 AND close_date IS NULL
    AND (open_date IS NULL OR open_date <= (SELECT s FROM ly) - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)
    AND store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.closure_start_date <= (SELECT e FROM ty) AND c.closure_end_date >= (SELECT s FROM ly) AND NOT (c.closure_end_date < (SELECT s FROM ty) AND c.closure_start_date < (SELECT s FROM ly)) AND FALSE)
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period,
  round(100 * (sum(CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN (SELECT s FROM ty) AND (SELECT e FROM ty) THEN r.net_sales END)
             / sum(CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN (SELECT s FROM ly) AND (SELECT e FROM ly) THEN r.net_sales END) - 1), 2) AS lfl_net_sales_growth_pct
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN lfl_stores USING (store_id)
WHERE r.business_date BETWEEN (SELECT s FROM ly) AND (SELECT e FROM ly) OR r.business_date BETWEEN (SELECT s FROM ty) AND (SELECT e FROM ty)
